rule: Phone and chat offered only in opening hours
description: Customers can only join the phone or chat queue Mon-Fri 7:00-21:00 and Sat 8:00-17:00, never on a closed day.
problem: contacts recorded while the phones were closed
expected_note: Run 1 found 6,039 contacts offered before opening (agents logging in early); run 2 found 8 offered after closing (agents logging out late). Fixed at source and removed by remediation R01.
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM cc.contact c JOIN cc.dim_date d ON d.full_date = c.offered_ts::date
   WHERE c.channel_id IN (1, 2) AND (d.is_center_closed
     OR (d.day_of_week = 6 AND NOT c.offered_ts::time BETWEEN '08:00' AND '17:00')
     OR (d.day_of_week < 6 AND NOT c.offered_ts::time BETWEEN '07:00' AND '21:00'))

rule: Queued calls answered promptly after closing
description: Phone and chat contacts still being answered more than 15 minutes after closing time (calls waiting at close are answered, but not long after).
problem: calls answered long after closing time
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM cc.contact c JOIN cc.dim_date d ON d.full_date = c.answered_ts::date
   WHERE c.channel_id IN (1, 2) AND c.answered AND NOT d.is_center_closed
     AND c.answered_ts::time > CASE WHEN d.day_of_week = 6 THEN time '17:15' ELSE time '21:15' END

description: Columns with a single distinct value across many rows: a flag or category that never varies usually means a broken feed or generator.
problem: a data field that never changed
expected_note: Profile-driven rule. Allow-listed: dim_site.timezone (all sites are in Central time by design).
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM discovery.dq_column_profile WHERE run_id = {run_id} AND row_count > 1 AND distinct_count = 1
     AND (table_name, column_name) NOT IN (('dim_site', 'timezone'))

rule: Launch product openings spread over time
description: Products launched in the period whose openings fall on fewer than half of the days the product has been available (capped at 100 days): real customers do not all open accounts on the same few dates.
problem: new product openings bunched on a few days
expected_note: Run 4: P2P Payments, High-Yield Savings and others opened on as few as 4 distinct days (generator defect, fixed by 07b_customer_products.sql).
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT cp.product_id, min(p.introduced_date) AS intro FROM cc.customer_product cp JOIN cc.dim_product p USING (product_id)
     WHERE p.is_new_in_period GROUP BY 1
     HAVING count(DISTINCT cp.open_date) < 0.5 * least(100, discovery.snapshot_date() - min(p.introduced_date))) x
